issues.title: User registration, login & logout
issues.body:
Session + CSRF based authentication.

- Register with username/email/password
- Login/logout
- Session persists across requests (cross-origin cookie support between Vercel frontend and Render backend)

issues.title: Mountain database (Wainwrights, Munros, Nuttalls)
issues.body: Full UK hill dataset sourced from DOBIH, organised into regions and subregions, grouped into collections (Wainwrights, Munros, Nuttalls).

issues.title: Explore mountains — search & filter
issues.body: Browse the mountain database with search, and filters by collection and region.

issues.title: Mountain detail page
issues.body: Dedicated page per mountain showing height, prominence, region, and a summary.

issues.title: Log a summit (completed / planned)
issues.body: Mark a mountain as completed or planned, with a date and notes.

issues.title: Dashboard — progress stats
issues.body: Completion stats and progress breakdowns by collection and region.

issues.title: Interactive UK map
issues.body: Leaflet-based map of the UK showing pins for mountains, filterable by completion status.

issues.title: Multi-mountain route logging
issues.body: Group several summits completed on the same outing into a single logged route.

issues.title: Detailed hike tracking per log
issues.body: Capture distance, duration, steps, flights climbed, conditions and season for each logged summit.

issues.title: Photo upload & gallery
issues.body: Attach a photo to a summit log, with a dedicated gallery page to browse them.

issues.title: Tiered achievements / badges
issues.body: Bronze/Silver/Gold achievement tiers across summit count, distance, steps, elevation and routes logged.

issues.title: Activity heatmap
issues.body: Calendar heatmap visualising logged activity over time on the dashboard.

issues.title: CSV bulk import of existing logs
issues.body: Import previously recorded summit logs in bulk from a CSV file.

issues.title: CSV / GPX export
issues.body: Export completed logs as CSV or GPX for use in other tools.

issues.title: Email reminders for planned summits
issues.body: Optional email reminder sent ahead of a planned summit date, toggled per-user via a notification preference.

issues.title: Collection notes / journal
issues.body: Free-text journal notes attached to a mountain collection.

issues.title: Public share link for a single log
issues.body: Read-only, no-auth-required share page for an individual summit log.

issues.title: Demo dashboard preview for logged-out visitors
issues.body: Curated placeholder stats shown on the dashboard when nobody is logged in, so visitors get a feel for the product.

issues.title: Account profile editing
issues.body: Update profile details (name, email) from the account page.
